const SIGNING_PEPPER = "e09216ca5867086cb2cb299f9326011c5307d0a9822b6760bfe12c45018c62ef";

const COOKIE = '__Host-cv_session', TTL = 8*60*60;
const enc = new TextEncoder();
const attempts = new Map(); // Limite local por instância, não substitui proteção global.
const base = {'Cache-Control':'no-store, private','X-Robots-Tag':'noindex, nofollow','X-Content-Type-Options':'nosniff','Referrer-Policy':'no-referrer','X-Frame-Options':'DENY'};
const csp = "default-src 'none'; script-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'; img-src 'self' data:; connect-src 'self'; form-action 'self'; base-uri 'none'; frame-ancestors 'none'";
const html = (body,status=200) => new Response(body,{status,headers:{...base,'Content-Type':'text/html; charset=utf-8','Content-Security-Policy':csp}});
const json = (obj,status=200) => new Response(JSON.stringify(obj),{status,headers:{...base,'Content-Type':'application/json; charset=utf-8'}});
const redirect = (location,cookie) => new Response(null,{status:303,headers:{...base,Location:location,...(cookie?{'Set-Cookie':cookie}:{})}});
const cookie = (value,age) => COOKIE+'='+value+'; Path=/; Max-Age='+age+'; HttpOnly; Secure; SameSite=Strict';
const hex = b => Array.from(new Uint8Array(b),x=>x.toString(16).padStart(2,'0')).join('');
const digest = async s => hex(await crypto.subtle.digest('SHA-256',enc.encode(s)));
function equal(a,b){if(a.length!==b.length)return false;let d=0;for(let i=0;i<a.length;i++)d|=a.charCodeAt(i)^b.charCodeAt(i);return d===0;}
async function signature(payload,password){const key=await crypto.subtle.importKey('raw',enc.encode(SIGNING_PEPPER+'\0'+password),{name:'HMAC',hash:'SHA-256'},false,['sign']);return hex(await crypto.subtle.sign('HMAC',key,enc.encode(payload)));}
async function issue(password){const payload=String(Math.floor(Date.now()/1000)+TTL)+'.'+hex(crypto.getRandomValues(new Uint8Array(16)));return payload+'.'+await signature(payload,password);}
async function valid(request,password){const token=(request.headers.get('Cookie')||'').split(';').map(s=>s.trim()).find(s=>s.startsWith(COOKIE+'='))?.slice(COOKIE.length+1)||'';const m=token.match(/^(\d{10})\.([a-f0-9]{32})\.([a-f0-9]{64})$/);if(!m||Number(m[1])<=Math.floor(Date.now()/1000))return false;return equal(m[3],await signature(m[1]+'.'+m[2],password));}
function login(message='',status=200){return html(LOGIN.replace('<!--MESSAGE-->',message?'<div class="error" role="alert">'+message+'</div>':''),status);}
function allowance(ip){const now=Date.now(),old=attempts.get(ip);if(old&&old.until>now)return old;if(attempts.size>=5000){for(const [k,v] of attempts)if(v.until<=now)attempts.delete(k);if(attempts.size>=5000)attempts.delete(attempts.keys().next().value);}const entry={count:0,until:now+600000};attempts.set(ip,entry);return entry;}
export default {async fetch(request,env){
  const incoming=new URL(request.url),password=env.PANEL_PASSWORD;
  if(typeof password!=='string'||!password)return html('<h1>Acesso temporariamente indisponível</h1><p>O administrador precisa configurar a senha do painel.</p>',503);
  if(incoming.pathname==='/login'&&request.method==='POST'){
    if(request.headers.get('Origin')!==incoming.origin)return json({error:'Origem não autorizada'},403);
    if(!(request.headers.get('Content-Type')||'').startsWith('application/x-www-form-urlencoded'))return json({error:'Formato inválido'},400);
    if(Number(request.headers.get('Content-Length')||0)>4096)return json({error:'Requisição muito grande'},413);
    const ip=request.headers.get('CF-Connecting-IP')||'unknown',entry=allowance(ip);
    if(entry.count>=8)return login('Muitas tentativas. Tente novamente mais tarde.',429);
    entry.count++;
    let value='';try{const body=await request.text();if(body.length>4096)return json({error:'Requisição muito grande'},413);value=new URLSearchParams(body).get('password')||'';}catch{return login('Não foi possível ler a senha.',400);}
    if(value.length>256||!equal(await digest(value),await digest(password)))return login('Senha incorreta. Tente novamente.',401);
    attempts.delete(ip);return redirect('/',cookie(await issue(password),TTL));
  }
  if(incoming.pathname==='/logout'&&request.method==='POST'){
    if(request.headers.get('Origin')!==incoming.origin)return json({error:'Origem não autorizada'},403);
    return redirect('/',cookie('',0));
  }
  if(request.method!=='GET')return json({error:'Método não permitido'},405);
  const authorized=await valid(request,password);
  if(incoming.pathname==='/'){
    if(!incoming.searchParams.has('url'))return authorized?html(PANEL):login();
    if(!authorized)return json({error:'Sessão ausente ou expirada'},401);
    let u;try{u=new URL(incoming.searchParams.get('url'));}catch{return json({error:'URL inválida'},400);}
    if(!permitted(u))return json({error:'Rota não permitida'},403);
    try{
      const r=await fetch(u.href,{headers:{Accept:'application/json'},redirect:'manual',cache:'no-store'});
      if(r.status>=300&&r.status<400)return json({error:'Redirecionamento inesperado na API oficial',status:r.status},502);
      const body=await r.text();if(!r.ok)return json({error:'Erro na API oficial',status:r.status,detail:body.slice(0,500)},r.status===401?502:r.status);
      try{JSON.parse(body);}catch{return json({error:'A API oficial não retornou JSON'},502);}
      return new Response(body,{status:200,headers:{...base,'Content-Type':'application/json; charset=utf-8'}});
    }catch(e){return json({error:'Falha ao consultar a API oficial',detail:String(e.message||e).slice(0,200)},502);}
  }
  return json({error:'Página não encontrada'},404);
}};
